subject.title: fix(gateway): don't retire parent Codex binding when creating a detached dashboard child

question: Should `sessions.create` gain an explicit caller-provided lifecycle disposition that distinguishes a parallel dashboard child from a child that replaces the selected parent?
rationale: The server does not maintain a canonical current-session pointer, and the contributor confirms that dashboard key shape alone cannot prove succession; maintainers must define which Control UI and TUI creations replace their parent.

options.title: Add explicit disposition
options.body: Extend the create contract and callers to declare parallel versus replacement behavior, preserving parent `session_end` only for genuine replacement.

options.title: Accept dashboard heuristic
options.body: Treat all dashboard-keyed children as parallel and intentionally change the lifecycle contract established by the earlier Control UI `/new` fix.

options.title: Narrow the fix
options.body: Pause this PR and implement a smaller discriminator limited to the demonstrated channel-parent creation path once that path can be identified reliably.

recommendation.title: Add explicit disposition
recommendation.body: Extend the create contract and callers to declare parallel versus replacement behavior, preserving parent `session_end` only for genuine replacement.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged Control UI lifecycle work is the clearest provenance for the contract this decision would revise.
